home.heading: Complete Your Safety Induction
home.subheading: Please complete your safety induction before proceeding to site.

form.duplicateId: The same ID / passport number appears more than once in this group. Each person needs their own unique number.

topics.heading: Safety Induction Topics
topics.instructions: Read each topic, then answer the question correctly to continue.
topics.acknowledge: I have read and understood this section

signature.heading: Signature
signature.instructions: Please sign below to confirm you have completed this induction.
signature.required: Please provide your signature before submitting
signature.groupInstructions: The group representative signs below to confirm that every person listed has completed this induction.

certificate.title: Certificate of Safety Induction
certificate.statement: This certifies that the person named below has completed the Miraj Media safety induction and is authorised to proceed to site, subject to compliance with all site rules.
certificate.groupInstructions: Each person has their own certificate with its own number and QR code.

verify.heading: Certificate Verification
verify.instructions: Enter a certificate number or scan the QR code on the certificate.
verify.name: Name
verify.scanning: Point the camera at the QR code on the certificate.
verify.cameraError: Could not access the camera. Allow camera access for this site, or use "Scan from a photo" instead.
verify.cameraUnsupported: This browser cannot open the camera. Use "Scan from a photo" or type the certificate number.
verify.noQrInPhoto: No QR code found in that photo. Try again with a clearer, closer photo.
verify.notACertificateQr: That QR code is not a certificate from this system.
verify.checkAgainstId: Check the name and ID above against the person's ID document. If either differs from the certificate you were shown, the certificate has been altered — do not accept it.

admin.eventCode: Code (used in certificate numbers, e.g. DXB25)
admin.eventFormError: Event name and code are required.
admin.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, ID, or company...
admin.noEvents: No events yet — add one above.
admin.confirmDeleteOne: Delete this inductee record? This cannot be undone.
admin.confirmDeleteMany: Delete the selected inductee records? This cannot be undone.
admin.deleteFailed: Delete failed — check your connection and try again.
admin.confirmDeleteEvent: Delete this event? This cannot be undone.
admin.confirmDeleteEventWithCerts: This event has certificates issued against it. Deleting the event will not delete those certificates or inductee records — they'll just no longer be linked to this event. Continue?
admin.marshalPinHelp: Marshals enter this PIN on the Marshal Scan screen for this event. Change it any time — marshals will need the new one next time they open the scan screen online.
admin.attendanceInstructions: Arrivals recorded by marshals scanning certificates each day. Figures update once a marshal's phone has synced.
admin.noAttendance: No arrivals recorded yet for this event.

quiz.correct: Correct — well done. Moving to the next topic.
quiz.incorrect: Not quite — have another look and try again.

events.heading: Select Your Event
events.instructions: Choose the event you're attending. If you don't see it listed, check with your site supervisor.
events.none: There are no active events right now. Please check with your event organiser.

video.heading: Safety Induction Video
video.instruction: Please watch the full video before continuing. The Continue button unlocks once it ends.
video.fallbackNotice: The video in your language is not available yet, so the English video is being shown.
video.loadError: The video could not be loaded. Check your connection and reload the page.

photo.heading: Photo
photo.instructions: This photo is shown on your certificate so it can be checked against you in person.
photo.cameraError: Could not access the camera. Please allow camera access for this site and try again.
photo.cameraUnsupported: This browser can't open the camera. Please try a different browser or device.
